label: Whether National Acoustics Laboratories-Revised (NAL-R) linear prescriptive formula (NAL) was completed or not - word in noise - Insight46 phase 1
meta_rows: Whether National Acoustics Laboratories-Revised (NAL-R) linear prescriptive formula (NAL) was completed or not - word in noise - Insight46 phase 1

Insight46 phase 1 word in noise. High-frequency monosyllabic words are presented against background noise, and the sound level of each word is varied, to obtain a "speech reception threshold" which represents the ability of the participant to identify words in background noise . Not collected at phase 2.
cat_rows: This category contains information on the Pure tone audiometry and words presented against background noise collected as part of the Insight46 sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
